feature: MCP 与 Skills 配置及聊天接入
environment: Explicit isolated temporary Lake home with a loopback MCP/model fixture; no external model or production service requests.
verified: Settings contains MCP and Skills tabs, unified AppSelect transport selection and Glyph icons.
MCP configuration saves without connecting, retains masked credentials, tests a real initialize/tools-list handshake and displays the tool schema.
HTTP, SSE and stdio SDK transports pass tests; cached SSE connection survives cancellation of the discovery request.
Chat executes list_mcp_servers, list_mcp_tools and call_mcp_tool against the loopback echo service.
Disabling silent commands makes the MCP call wait for an operation decision; approving resumes the call.
MCP configuration changes invalidate connections; server disablement blocks further calls; private header/env values are scrubbed from tool output.
Unconfigured or entirely disabled MCP services do not consume the default model tool budget.
UI creates service-check SKILL.md, imports an existing directory without copying support files and displays imported content read-only.
Chat loads the enabled service-check Skill and rejects loading it after disablement.
Skill content, enablement and imported root metadata survive backend restart.
Invalid stdio JSON parameters produce a visible in-form error without saving or starting a process.
Light/dark desktop layouts and 430x840 MCP/Skills layouts have no horizontal page overflow; mobile sources, editor and save controls remain scrollable.

automated.typescript: Passed standalone check and final production build.
automated.go_latest: Extension, skill-isolation, MCP permission and configuration tests rerun after final storage hardening; passed.
automated.codesign: Signed Dev build and installation succeeded; strict signature verification succeeded.

desktop.status: Verified after macOS unlock: relaunched the signed installed Lake Dev, opened MCP and Skills tabs, checked empty states, MCP creation form and all three transport options, Skill editor/template and directory manager. Returned to chat without saving test configurations. Release app and data were untouched.

limitations: Authentication uses custom headers/env; interactive OAuth login is not implemented.
